# Clipboard to Markdown (Chrome Extension)

> ClipMD is a Chrome extension that lets developers and power users instantly copy any webpage element as Markdown or a screenshot by pressing a keyboard shortcut, eliminating manual copy-paste formatting work.

## Guide

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/clipmd/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Source Modules

- [scripts.build](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/clipmd/blob/main/scripts/build.py)
- [turndown](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/clipmd/blob/main/turndown.js)
